message: 思い出は炭酸の味

name: Misa
message: 「With this, we conclude the Ryuusei Academy Sparkle Festival. Good work, everyone」

name: Synn
message: 「All right. Once you've got that end, we'll lift on three. One, two, three」

name: Eddie
message: 「Okay. Alright, let's move it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Take down all those decorations, okay~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oka~y」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This past month. We spent so long preparing, yet it was over in the blink of an eye」

name: Ria
message: 「That just goes to show how much fun it was」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It feels kind of lonely, doesn't it? Everything going right back to normal in just a single day」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Still, it makes you wanna hold onto the memories that much tighter, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. These have become wonderful memories. Don't you think so, Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going home」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my, he finished cleaning up before I even noticed」

name: Ria
message: 「Bye-bye~ See ya later~」

name: Shio
message: 「As my duties are now complete, I shall take my leave ahead of you」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm heading home too~」

name: Misa
message: 「Be careful walking home in the dark」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks, everyone. Good work today」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san. Do we have any trash bags left?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry, we're all out. Pretty sure HQ still has some extras」

name: Misa
message: 「Got it. I'll go grab some real quick」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... I think that's the last of the equipment cleared out」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yo, Synn. Thanks for all your help today」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, thank you. Really appreciate all your hard work」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Thanks to you, I got to soak up plenty of gossip and youthful energy」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. Your skin really is smooth」

name: Shina-oba
message: 「Oh, stop it, you. It's makeup, makeup」

name: Tame-san
message: 「I sure hope you do it again next year」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, next year will be up to the next Student Council to decide~」

name: Helena
message: 「It depends on how whoever becomes the next Student Council president felt about experiencing today」

name: Helena
message: 「If they had fun, I'm sure they'll be able to do it next year too」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... I sure hope so」

name: Helena
message: 「Maybe this event will even spark a flood of people wanting to become Student Council president」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That might be exaggerating a bit」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Dahaha. I'm counting on it. See ya」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. Please get home safely~」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee. Did I tease you a little too much?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all. If anything, it makes me happy, or rather... ahaha, what am I saying, that's embarrassing」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm sure Ria is happy too, knowing you're the ones who succeeded her」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, the real battle starts now. I'm wishing the Student Council the best of luck」
Helena-san. She's always fooling around, yet every now and then she says things with a serious look like that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whatcha doin'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... oh, it's you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with that gloomy mug? C'mon, cleanup's pretty much done, so let's get goin'」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, where to?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「After a festival, there's only one thing to do, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Too late?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh, enough with the nonsense already! It's wrap-up party time, wrap-up party」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, let's go, let's go! Hurry up, hurry up~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, hold on. Wait up--!」

name: Ria
message: 「Welcome back, Synn-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, where were you slacking off?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I've gotten quite tired of waiting, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone... wait, th-th-this is!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa there, calm down. Well, I doubt you can, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-the thing I've even seen in my dreams――」

name: Synn
message: 「Cider!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Apparently Kawana-san's family sent it over as a treat」

name: Synn
message: 「Cider!」

name: Ria
message: 「Fizz~」

name: Synn
message: 「Cideeer!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fizz-fizz~」

name: Synn
message: 「Cideeeeer!」

name: Misa
message: 「F-fizz~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright then, everyone. Thank you all so much for your hard work」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you for your hard work~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though it is only a modest gathering... ahem. To celebrate today's huge success――」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you the one running the show, Nanaka-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's acting as the President's interpreter, isn't she」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, cideeeeeer!」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, Synn. Everyone's waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah--whoops, my bad. I just got a little carried away with how happy I am...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! Hurry♪ Hurry♪」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well then... everyone, hands at the ready」

name: Misa
message: 「It's not like we're doing a ceremonial hand-clap」
Everyone holds a bottle of cider in their hand.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm truly glad we made it through safely without any accidents. I'm really, truly happy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And because there's cider, too」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't deny it today! With that said, cheers!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Cheeeeers」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, how does the cider you've been dreaming about taste?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, but it's way, waaaay more 'delicious' than any of the 'delicious' times before!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, it is just as the President says. To think a plain bottle of carbonated water could taste this sweet!」

name: Ria
message: 「This isn't sparkling water, though\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, being able to drink cider like this... I'm sooo glad I became Student Council President~~~」

name: Misa
message: 「You could drink it as Vice President too, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, good for you too then, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「It's sarcasm, sarcasm!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really are happy, aren't you? One of your dreams came true, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, would that be making the event a success as Student Council President?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nope. Drinking cider」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Wha, well, that's true too, but... I'm happy about what you said too, Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「R-Right~\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief... I still can't accept that someone this frivolous is the Student Council President」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so? Then, I'll do it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, that might be a great idea」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Nanaka」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nice to meet you. I am the President, Lolotte Rosenkreuz」

name: Ria
message: 「Then you'll have to do everything in Synn-kun's place, right\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I respectfully resign effective immediately」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not what I meant in the first place!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know. Today only succeeded because everyone was here」

name: Misa
message: 「Naturally. Failure is not an option for us. We must always strive for victory!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President is the number one person you wouldn't want to make an enemy of, isn't she」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if I should be happy about that」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone combined their strength for a huge success. It turned out to be a truly wonderful event, didn't it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Truly what you'd call a rose-colored school life, wouldn't you say, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah! Aaalright. Let's work harder and harder, and make our school life even more rose-colored and sparkling!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeaaah!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, so. Is there still any cider left over?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't get so worked up with stars in your eyes. We got plenty extra, so don't worry--」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmmm~, nothing beats a bottle of this for a tired body. Pwahhh, this cider's delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sally-chan...」

name: Sally
message: 「Burp. Thanks for the treat」
